summary: Boston Properties Limited Partnership filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $700 million offering of 6.050% senior notes due 2036. The notes were priced at 99.837% of par, with underwriting discounts and proceeds of approximately $694.3 million before expenses. Interest accrues from August 31, 2026, payable semiannually. This is a routine debt issuance by an operating partnership, not a special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing lacks any special-situation catalysts, and the notes are unsecured senior obligations not listed on an exchange. There are no deal terms applicable; the offering is standard financing activity.
